M-WIDGET.Purpose: Base declarative Widget with flat Behavior-backed Props, lifecycle and input/render hooks, layout geometry and native IMGUI child-context hooks.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Behavior-backed Widget Props for children, Flexbox dimensions/margins/padding/borders, transforms, Overflow and ZIndex.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Lifecycle hooks, OnGUI and paired native child-context hooks with explicit viewport input and ChildrenGuiSpace output.
Scope.SCP-IN-003: Self transforms Translate, Scale, Rotate and TransformOrigin; independent GetChildrenTransform for child-space transforms.
Scope.SCP-IN-004: WidgetList, ImplicitKey and GetProperty(key) for generated Refs.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: Instance reconciliation, layout calculation, render traversal and pointer targeting are external responsibilities; the base Widget provides declarations and hooks.
Scope.SCP-OUT-002: Published geometry and clipping queries are owned by M-WIDGET-GEOMETRY, M-TRANSFORM-SERVICE and M-CLIP-SERVICE.
Scope.SCP-OUT-003: Generated property setters/slots — owned by M-WIDGET-EMITTER.

Requirements.REQ-001: Layout and visual properties are flat [Prop] Behavior slots; reserved base layout names update Flexbox through generated emitters without an independent Style category.
Requirements.REQ-002: OnGUI receives the engine-supplied calculated layout rectangle; it does not calculate layout or render children itself.
Requirements.REQ-003: GetProperty(string key) returns Refs[key] as IPropertyRef or null, with no per-call reflection or allocation.
Requirements.REQ-004: WidgetRenderer owns GUI.matrix and render orchestration; Widget declares no-op child-context hooks and stores no transient renderer state.
Requirements.REQ-005: WidgetRenderer supplies standard padding-box clipping unless the native context returned by a concrete widget already clips children; the renderer closes its clip before calling EndChildrenGUI.
Requirements.REQ-006: Widget declares self-transform Props; WidgetGeometryBuilder computes their matrices without affecting Flexbox layout.
Requirements.REQ-007: ZIndex is local to siblings; negative values and stable equal-index ties do not mutate the source Children list.

Inputs.IN-002: FlexEvent via mouse, keyboard and scroll hooks.
Inputs.IN-003: Calculated viewport in the incoming GUI coordinate space, passed explicitly to BeginChildrenGUI.

Outputs.OUT-001: Widget definition tree from BuildRenderTree and native IMGUI drawing within host rect.
Outputs.OUT-002: ChildrenGuiSpace reports native origin, applied child transform and child clipping; GetChildrenTransform supplies the content transform.

SideEffects.EFF-001: Widget hooks can modify instance State, issue draw calls and open/close native IMGUI scopes.
